item.title: CROWDFUNDING RADAR: Rachel Sumer and Traveling Light, Seth Kibel, and Marc Gunn
item.description: The slow winter months in the crowdfunding landscape provide fewer artists for me to choose who gets featured here. I usually try to theme each month's column, picking three artists who have a similar style, type of perk, etc. that tells a story about the world of crowdfunding.
